transcriber_notes: Rows: 20 data rows + 2 sub-heading rows (Factory:, Finance and commerce:) + Total + Percentage, as printed.

Row totals: the printed Total differs from the sum of the seven cause columns in 11 rows — Mining: row parts sum to 14, printed Total 15; woodwork: row parts sum to 3, printed Total 4; bricks: row parts sum to 8, printed Total 10; textiles: row parts sum to 55, printed Total 61; clothing: row parts sum to 14, printed Total 18; food, drink: row parts sum to 13, printed Total 14; others: row parts sum to 13, printed Total 15; Transport: row parts sum to 47, printed Total 57; general: row parts sum to 8, printed Total 11; hotel employees: row parts sum to 16, printed Total 21; Officials: row parts sum to 6, printed Total 7. The differences add up to 34 (= 12 trade unionism + 13 collective agreement + 9 system of working, cf. footnote * and the lists in tables/p0351_5.json), and match those lists row by row where the industries correspond (e.g. textiles +6 = 4 + 2, Mining +1, Transport +10 = 3 + 3 + 4), so the Total column evidently includes those 34 cases.

Column sums of the rows: Wages 86 (printed 91), Hours 8 (printed 8), Dismissals 52 (printed 53), Treatment 38 (printed 39), Regulations 4 (printed 4), Lockouts 5 (printed 5), Various 43 (printed 44), Total 272 (printed 278*). Wages, Dismissals, Treatment and Various columns do NOT reconcile with their printed totals (diffs 5, 1, 1, 1); Total column rows sum to 272 vs printed 278 (diff 6). Cells re-read; transcribed as printed.
Sum of the printed column totals 91+8+53+39+4+5+44 = 244 (printed 278*). 278 − 244 = 34, the cases in footnote *.
Sum of printed percentages = 102.79 (printed 100†). — does not reconcile (the † footnote says 100 includes 12.24% from the other three categories; 102.79 + 12.24 ≠ 100).
